definitions.samples: 5s/15s after DOMContentLoaded, with actual timestamp/lateness; keep tab foreground and leave viewport/scroll untouched for initial-load runs.
definitions.resourceTiming: Completed response transferSize includes headers. Legacy requests/transferBytes exclude HTML and ledger polling, but include injected measurement JS. Canonical site totals exclude all measurement endpoints.
definitions.serverLedger: Local body bytes successfully written to sockets, including in-flight/aborted ranges. No headers, HTML or diagnostic endpoints in site totals. Client requested/received timestamps bound snapshot delay; OS queues can precede browser receipt.
definitions.synchronization: Same callback/mediaTime copied to all composite canvases; verifies shared decoded frame, not semantic content alignment within the encoded atlas.
definitions.controls: Diagnostic seek/play/pause actions override selected media for inspection and are logged; do not use during untouched initial-load runs.
definitions.network: Preview throttling affects local origins only. Use separate ports for concurrent test pages and a unique run=LABEL for each intentional run; duplicate HTML fetches/reloads with the same label reuse its ledger.
